purpose: Buyer-flow comparison set (28 November 2026). Sixteen requests written before any arm ran on them. None is in the frozen 20, the six reserved confirmation requests, the development set or the robustness set. They name mainstream products that several directory shops list (checked against the local catalog pulled the same day), so the comparison measures the buyer flow, not shop coverage. Not a held-out acceptance set: it is used once, to compare designs.
